question: What temperature did sensor 999.0 measure on 2004-02-28 at 00:00:00?
graph_cypher:
MATCH (s:Sensor {mote_id: 999.0})-[:GENERATED]->(m:Measurement)
WHERE m.time STARTS WITH "2004-02-28T00:00:00"
RETURN m.time AS time, m.temperature AS value
ORDER BY m.time ASC
LIMIT 1
